entry.name: trayLayout
entry.label: Tray layout: auto, icon, compact or wide.

entry.name: detailLayout
entry.label: Detail header layout: auto, stacked or side.

entry.name: icon
entry.label: Tray icon name, or "auto" for the built-in headset icon.

entry.name: batteryGlyphSide
entry.label: With batteryDisplay "both": which side the glyph sits ("left" or "right").

entry.name: batteryOverlay
entry.label: Badge the battery on the headset icon instead of beside it.

entry.name: trayOrder
entry.label: Left-to-right order of the tray pieces: comma list of icon, info, battery.

entry.name: batteryFont
entry.label: Font family for the tray battery text; empty = system default.

entry.name: batteryFontSize
entry.label: Font size (pt) for the tray battery text; 0 = automatic.

entry.name: nameFont
entry.label: Font family for the tray device-name text; empty = system default.

entry.name: nameFontSize
entry.label: Font size (pt) for the tray device-name text; 0 = automatic.

entry.name: statusFont
entry.label: Font family for the tray status (codec/mode) text; empty = system default.

entry.name: statusFontSize
entry.label: Font size (pt) for the tray status (codec/mode) text; 0 = automatic.

entry.name: batteryColor
entry.label: Colour for the tray battery text; empty = theme default.

entry.name: nameColor
entry.label: Colour for the tray device-name text; empty = theme default.

entry.name: statusColor
entry.label: Colour for the tray status (codec/mode) text; empty = theme default.

entry.name: infoStatusTop
entry.label: Stack the wide tray info cell with the status line above the device name.
